title: GNSS for Autonomous Navigation
dek: Positioning and multi-sensor navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles, autonomous vehicles, and intelligent transport systems.
body: This research area studies how GNSS and complementary sensors support autonomous navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles and ground vehicles.
UAVLab provides an open-source simulation environment for UAV dynamics, satellite navigation, inertial sensing, LiDAR, cameras, atmospheric effects, and urban signal blockage.
